headline: Allegion (ALLE) Stock Gets Fair Value Bump After Mixed Analyst Target Changes
summary: Allegion’s updated analyst fair value estimate has shifted from about US$164 to roughly US$169.82 per share, sitting within a wider range of recent price targets that span roughly US$142 to US$170. This change lines up with Street commentary that is split between higher targets from bullish firms after Q2 results and lower targets from more cautious analysts who question how much investors should pay for the stock. As you read on, you will see how these moves feed into the evolving Allegion...
